principle: A technical failure must never count as successful contradiction detection.

frozen_a0.role: historical baseline and operational reference; not the paired A0 reference

A0.paired_reference: new run under this protocol, frozen artifact untouched

A2.description: typed conflict records, no duplicate-based resolution

runs.paired_reference: same evidence, questions and call order per arm, replayed from a Jev cassette
runs.live_rule: independent live runs for operational stability; never replaces the paired reference

cassette.new_calls: A2/A3 calls without a matching entry run live and are labelled

semantic_quality.clean: every required model judgement for that decision completed; no timeout, invalid answer or budget omission affected it
semantic_quality.excluded: technical failures are excluded from numerator and denominator and reported separately

operational_quality.rule: no sufficient verdict may depend on a failed call

execute_vs_semantic.execution: all selected work handled; deterministic process control
execute_vs_semantic.semantic: evidence that relevant contradictions were not missed; requires a facit or a verifiable strategy
execute_vs_semantic.without_facit: semantic coverage is not_measured, never complete

pair_states: not_selected: candidate ranking excluded the pair
budget_omitted: selected as candidate but did not fit the budget
unevaluated: selected for Jev but could not be judged

budget.note: prove candidate filtering keeps decisive contradictions before raising the budget

cost.rule: cost is reported next to quality; no arm may win on quality alone without its cost

semantic.assert: quality PASS + route final_outcome uncertain is never sufficient
a forced 0.95 contradiction stays unresolved at duplicate 0.89
tail_counterevidence, late_evidence and independent_contradiction are not sufficient in clean runs
short_sufficient stays sufficient; compatible_periods/compatible_entities are not false contradictions
clean false-sufficient rate <= clean A0 reference

operational.assert: technical_failure_rate is reported and every failed call is traceable
a verdict difference across live reps is explained by a recorded technical failure
no alternate model, retry policy or degraded mode appears in an arm
